🔒 Ethics & Safety

Privacy

In simple words

Your right to control your personal information and who can see it.

Your right to control your personal information. AI systems often collect and use lots of data, so it matters what you share and who can see it.

Example. Before pasting your address, a password or a friend's photo into an AI app, ask yourself: where could this information end up?

Lessons that teach it

  • Lesson 6: AI Ethics & Safety
  • Lesson 11: Can You Trust AI?

Related words

  • DataFacts and information a computer can store and use, such as numbers, words, pictures and clicks.
  • DeepfakeA fake video, image or voice recording made with AI that shows someone saying or doing something they never did.
  • Recommendation systemAn AI system that suggests things you might like, based on what you and similar people chose before.
